releaseNotes:
Feature: Cursor chats cleanup by project (age filter, progress, VACUUM)
Feature: Purge orphan agentKv blobs / composer.content to reclaim multi-GB DB bloat
Feature: Daily Cursor auto-clean (chats + orphans + cache/backups) with Telegram report
Fix: empty-state-draft no longer aborts the whole chat delete job
Fix: ItemTable auth/login keys verified and never deleted
Fix: Auto-clean no longer runs immediately on enable (waits for next scheduled time)
Fix: Safe disk clear also removes state.vscdb.gdp-bak-* backups
